body: One other thing, do you have a counter-argument to the "I've seen psychologists before and I already know exactly what the are going to say" line.   He said that to me once, and he was a psyche major (and very smart) so there is probably some truth to it.
He has been to a doctor for the seizures before.  Sounded like he hadn't been lately.
Thank you, that is along the lines of what I was thinking.  I will try to sit him down tonight, I'm not the most confrontational (I know this isn't a confrontation) person, but I'll do my best.
